infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VINTAGE shows you the photographs in your library, and when each was taken, so you can find one to share. They are read on this iPhone; nothing is uploaded unless you post it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VINTAGE needs camera access so you can take photographs to share.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VINTAGE does not record sound. Its camera takes photographs; a film you post comes from your library.

plugins.faceIDPermission: VINTAGE does not use Face ID.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: When you choose Save Image or Save Video in the share sheet, VINTAGE adds that print to your library. It adds nothing else.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: VINTAGE does not track where you are. It only turns the place you type on a post into a point on your own map.
